project_identity.name: GONAXIS

project_identity.emotional_archetype: Trust & Growth with Modern Warm Precision

micro_animations.floating_effect: animate-bounce-slow or Framer Motion floating keyframes y: [-6, 6, -6] duration 4s ease-in-out infinite
micro_animations.card_hover: transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-cyan-500/10 hover:border-teal-500/40

testing_and_accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA high contrast text (#0F172A on #F8FAFC is > 12:1)
testing_and_accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: Supported via standard tailwind motion-reduce modifiers

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always use the French language text provided in the specs with warm, direct human tone.
Do NOT use stock photos of humans or robots. Build high-end interactive visual UI cards composition.
Include clear interactive elements such as business sector toggle in the hero card preview widget.
All buttons and links must have explicit hover states and data-testid attributes.
Header must be sticky with backdrop-blur glass effect and full mobile menu functionality.
Smooth scroll anchor links for #diagnostic and #comment-ca-marche.
